title: Read a Binary by Hand
description: A practical first module in manual ELF inspection: identify the file, map its header, read its segments, and separate runtime symbols from debug symbols — using only the bytes and a hex viewer.
author: Underlayer

assets.description: Real x86-64 ELF files copied byte-for-byte from the verified ELF corpus, with readelf evidence captured 2026-11-28.

exercise_decls.question: In the specimen's identification bytes, what does byte 4 equal and what does it tell you?
exercise_decls.explanation: 02 at offset 4 is EI_CLASS=ELF64, which is why the specimen uses a 64-byte header.
exercise_decls.hint1: Re-read the lesson section 'Check Your Understanding'.

exercise_decls.question: In the specimen, how large is the program-header table and where does it start?
exercise_decls.options: 64 bytes at offset 56|784 bytes at file offset 64|2368 bytes at file offset 16344
exercise_decls.explanation: 14 program headers times 56 bytes each is 784 bytes, starting at file offset 64.
exercise_decls.hint1: Re-read the lesson section 'Check Your Understanding'.

exercise_decls.question: Which program header names the program that finishes loading a dynamic executable?
exercise_decls.explanation: PT_INTERP holds the path /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 in this specimen, which is the interpreter the kernel starts.
exercise_decls.hint1: Re-read the lesson section 'Check Your Understanding'.

exercise_decls.question: Which table contains the row for main in this specimen?
exercise_decls.options: .dynsym|.symtab|Neither; main is only in a debug file
exercise_decls.explanation: readelf prints main as entry 35 of .symtab, value 0x11c9, size 105, GLOBAL DEFAULT in section 14.
exercise_decls.hint1: Re-read the lesson section 'Check Your Understanding'.

modules.title: First Look
modules.description: Establish what the file is and where its tables live.

modules.title: The Runtime View
modules.description: Read what the loader maps and what the linker records.

concepts.title: The First Sixteen Bytes
concepts.description: Identify class, byte order and ABI from e_ident before reading any other field.

concepts.title: The Header Is a Map
concepts.description: Use e_phoff, e_phentsize, e_phnum, e_shoff, e_shentsize and e_shnum to locate every table.

concepts.title: What the Loader Actually Maps
concepts.description: Read PT_PHDR, PT_INTERP and the four PT_LOAD entries of a real PIE.

concepts.title: Two Symbol Tables, Two Jobs
concepts.description: Separate the seven-entry .dynsym from the forty-three-entry .symtab and read binding and visibility.

toolchain: readelf 2.39 (GNU Binutils) reading pre-verified specimens produced by gcc 15.2.0 / clang 21.1.8
limitations: This is a first module, not a full course: four concepts, one architecture (x86-64), one file class (ELF64 little-endian).
No new byte, offset or format claim was authored: every number is read from the included readelf evidence or copied from the verified ELF corpus.
Producer toolchain versions are inherited from courses/elf/assets/samples/SOURCES.md; readelf 2.39 is the local reader, not the producer.
Specimen bundles are copied from the verified elf corpus, not executed on this Windows host.
